newsitem.title: SPAIN: TABLE-Tubacex H1 net profit up 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Tubacex H1 net profit up 15 pct.

text.p: First-half consolidated results for Spanish steel-tubing group Tubacex

NOTE - Tubacex said the decline in turnover stemmed from a fall in the price of nickel as well as lower sales by its Aceria de Alava unit. At this unit, Tubacex is emphasising return on sales, and plans to widen its range of value-added products and thus increase its contribution to profits.
Tubacex also said it expects a new capital reduction in the fourth quarter, with a payout to shareholders. This decrease will be bigger than that implemented in 1996, the firm said.
